summary.zh: 逐字段评估填写阻力，提升表单完成率
summary.en: Score field friction and raise form completion

description.zh: 分析线索、联系、演示预约或结账表单的字段阻力，指出可以删减或合并的项，并给出字段顺序调整建议。适合表单转化偏低或即将改版时使用。
description.en: Scores lead, contact, demo or checkout forms field by field, flags fields to cut or merge, and suggests a better order. Use it when a form converts poorly or before redesigning it.
